findings.title: `_red_case_required`'s `*/tests/inv/test_*.sh` match on `$0` silently fails open under relative invocation, and its own RED case uses an absolute path so it cannot detect this
for the two enrolled non-`tests/inv/` gates the rule is enforced textually only — a `red_case` call in a comment or an unreached branch satisfies `red_case_violations`, with no runtime counterpart
`tests/inv/test_INV-12_pack_overflow.sh`'s `# GREEN:` annotation delegates its twin to `tests/test_pack.sh`, so the annotation is satisfied while no GREEN case runs inside the enforced file
